name: Media Card
author: Lucas Picotti
description: Media controls for the Omarchy bar in three styles, with a card for the active player: cover, progress, transport, shuffle, repeat, volume and the other players.

barWidget.description: Now playing in the bar. Click opens the card, middle click plays or pauses, scroll changes the player's volume, right click switches players.

schema.label: Bar style
schema.description: How the widget looks in the bar. Cover with progress line takes the least room.

schema.label: Hide when nothing plays
schema.description: Removes the widget from the bar while no player has a track.

schema.label: Show player volume
schema.description: Adds the player's own volume slider to the card, when the player supports it.

schema.label: Show "Also playing"
schema.description: Lists the other players in the card. The player tabs stay either way.
